title: Resolved model
description: One page of the resolved model, the model as code generation sees it, as `GET /api/model/resolved` and the MCP tool `get_resolved_model` answer it. Records are flat: other objects appear by id. Contract 0.23.0: until version 1 the contract is the Maquettiste release and may change in any release. The reference is resolved-model.md, next to this file.

contract.description: The contract version the page follows: the version inside `resolved-model.json` of the same release. Until version 1 it is the Maquettiste release, and the contract may change in any release.

schema.description: The file name of the JSON Schema that describes the page: `resolved-model.json`. A project holds it in `.maquettiste/.schema/v1/`; `GET /api/model/resolved/schema` and the MCP tool `get_schema` (`resolved-model`) return it.

items.description: The records of the page, ordered by kind, then name, then id (ordinal); migration facts by database name, then applied order. Each record has `id`, `kind` and `name`, and `kind` says which record it is.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, or null on the last one.

diagnostics.description: When the model has errors, the errors that prevented resolution (and `items` is empty); otherwise the failures of the calculated values the page reads (MQ5010, MQ5011, MQ5013), and nothing else: validate reports the warnings.

calculated.description: The calculated values of the objects on the page and the sub-objects their records list, by site (the object's id, or `<holder id>/<attribute id>` for an attribute its holder does not own), then by name, ordinal. A value that fails is left out and its diagnostic is in `resolvedPage.diagnostics`; an object with no value is left out.
